retire_or_merge.scope: archive::echo — durable independent evidence within same physical package
records::dream — durable first-cycle/journal and codec, not Dream inference
records::external_index — separate replaceable external-source derived index
open/replay — exactly one canonical owner composition and grouped admission
import — source adapter/normalization and exclusive epoch workflow
Delete placeholder-only crate; future Ego synthesis may earn a service package when implemented

policy.root: reexports and narrow public API only; direct lower dependencies in root exist exclusively to reexport canonical public types
policy.domain_type_imports: semantic packages may import canonical immutable value types/pure helpers from store packages, not mutable store open/write/session APIs
policy.owner_composition: only reliquary-owner-session may assemble durable domain stores, replay and grouped session publication
policy.workflows: only application composes multiple semantic services and owner mutations; runtime invokes workflows
policy.gateway: runtime owns operational journals and host/Instance authority, never mutable domain stores
policy.no_extra: all unlisted package dependency edges are prohibited until a superseding decision
